summary: This is a Gherkin feature file that describes a user login test scenario in plain English. It outlines one test case where a user successfully logs in with correct credentials and ends up on the dashboard—this is the kind of specification that both developers and non-technical stakeholders can read and understand.

explanations.1: The 'Feature' keyword marks the start of a feature file and gives it a title; think of it as the test suite name.
explanations.2: A 'Scenario' is a single test case within the feature—in this case, we're testing what happens when someone logs in correctly.
explanations.3: The 'Given' step describes the initial state or precondition—the user needs to be positioned at the login page before we test anything.
explanations.4: The 'When' step describes the action the user takes—entering their username and password.
explanations.5: The 'Then' step describes the expected outcome or assertion—if login works, the user should see the dashboard page instead.
